title: Noise kernel rows sum to one
statement:
Fix a real number $\rho$ with $0 \le \rho \le 1$, and let $x$ be a point of the Boolean hypercube $\mathrm{BoolCube}\,n$. Then the noise kernel $K_\rho(x,y)$, summed over every point $y$ of the cube, equals one:
\[
  \sum_{y} K_\rho(x,y) \;=\; 1.
\]
hypotheses_covered: x a point of the Boolean hypercube of dimension n
sum over all y in the cube of K_ρ(x,y) equals 1
